# google_document_ai_evaluation

An evaluation of a ProcessorVersion's performance.


To get more information about Evaluation, see:

* [API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/document-ai/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.locations.processors.processorVersions.evaluations)
* How-to Guides
    * [Official Documentation](https://cloud.google.com/document-ai/docs/overview)

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `location` -
  (Required)
  The location ID.

* `processor` -
  (Required)
  The processor ID.

* `processor_version` -
  (Required)
  The processor version ID.


* `document_counters` -
  (Optional)
  Evaluation counters for the documents that were used.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_document_counters).

* `all_entities_metrics` -
  (Optional)
  Metrics for all the entities in aggregate.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_all_entities_metrics).

* `entity_metrics` -
  (Optional)
  Metrics across confidence levels, for different entities.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_entity_metrics).

* `kms_key_name` -
  (Optional)
  The KMS key name used for encryption.

* `kms_key_version_name` -
  (Optional)
  The KMS key version with which data is encrypted.

* `schema_version` -
  (Optional)
  SchemaVersion used during evaluation.
  Format is
  `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/schemas/{schema}/schemaVersions/{schema_version}`

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.



<a name="nested_document_counters"></a>The `document_counters` block supports:

* `input_documents_count` -
  (Optional)
  How many documents were sent for evaluation.

* `invalid_documents_count` -
  (Optional)
  How many documents were not included in the evaluation as they didn't pass validation.

* `failed_documents_count` -
  (Optional)
  How many documents were not included in the evaluation as Document AI failed to process them.

* `evaluated_documents_count` -
  (Optional)
  How many documents were used in the evaluation.

<a name="nested_all_entities_metrics"></a>The `all_entities_metrics` block supports:

* `confidence_level_metrics` -
  (Optional)
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_all_entities_metrics_confidence_level_metrics).

* `auprc` -
  (Optional)
  The AUPRC for metrics with fuzzy matching disabled, i.e., exact matching only

* `estimated_calibration_error` -
  (Optional)
  The ECE for the predicted entities with fuzzy matching disabled, i.e., exact matching only

* `auprc_exact` -
  (Optional)
  The AUPRC for metrics with fuzzy matching disabled, i.e., exact matching only.

* `estimated_calibration_error_exact` -
  (Optional)
  The ECE for the predicted entities with fuzzy matching disabled, i.e., exact matching only.

* `metrics_type` -
  (Optional)
  The metrics type for the label
  Possible values are: `METRICS_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED`, `AGGREGATE`.


<a name="nested_all_entities_metrics_confidence_level_metrics"></a>The `confidence_level_metrics` block supports:

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/processors/{{processor}}/processorVersions/{{processorVersion}}/evaluations/{{name}}`

* `name` -
  The resource name of the evaluation.
  Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/processors/{processor}/processorVersions/{processor_version}/evaluations/{evaluation}`

* `create_time` -
  The time that the evaluation was created.


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


Evaluation can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/processors/{{processor}}/processorVersions/{{processorVersion}}/evaluations/{{name}}`
* `{{project}}/{{location}}/{{processor}}/{{processorVersion}}/{{name}}`
* `{{location}}/{{processor}}/{{processorVersion}}/{{name}}`


In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import Evaluation using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/processors/{{processor}}/processorVersions/{{processorVersion}}/evaluations/{{name}}"
  to = google_document_ai_evaluation.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), Evaluation can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_document_ai_evaluation.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/processors/{{processor}}/processorVersions/{{processorVersion}}/evaluations/{{name}}
$ terraform import google_document_ai_evaluation.default {{project}}/{{location}}/{{processor}}/{{processorVersion}}/{{name}}
$ terraform import google_document_ai_evaluation.default {{location}}/{{processor}}/{{processorVersion}}/{{name}}
```
